stories.title: Trump’s EPA wants to let data centers hide their air pollution
stories.simple_summary: The EPA is planning to make it easier for companies to build large data centers without having to publicly announce the pollution they'll create. This removes a rule that used to let neighbors find out about and comment on the pollution.
stories.why_it_matters: If a data center gets built near your home or business, you might not find out about the air pollution it causes until it's too late to have a say in whether it happens.

stories.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
stories.simple_summary: A judge ruled that the Trump administration was wrong to label Anthropic (an AI company) as a supply-chain risk. Anthropic won this court case.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and Anthropic employees — nothing you need to act on, though it shows AI companies are fighting government restrictions.

stories.title: Meta executive leaves for OpenAI as the social media giant faces growing scrutiny in India
stories.simple_summary: A high-ranking worker at Meta (which owns Facebook) is leaving to work at OpenAI, another AI company. She will manage OpenAI's work in Southeast Asia and Australia.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry watchers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Anthropic was illegally blacklisted by the Trump administration, court rules
stories.simple_summary: A judge ruled the Pentagon's decision to blacklist Anthropic was unconstitutional and unfair. This is a legal victory for the AI company against the Trump administration.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and AI companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Anthropic and OpenAI are joining the AI stage at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.simple_summary: AI companies Anthropic and OpenAI will speak at a tech conference called TechCrunch Disrupt in 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just news about a conference — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Barret Zoph, the Thinking Machines co-founder ousted before joining OpenAI, is now at Google
stories.simple_summary: A person who started a small AI company and worked at OpenAI is now working at Google.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about job movement in the tech industry — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Google’s AI note-taking app now allows you to interact with books
stories.simple_summary: Google's note-taking app called Gemini Notebook can now read books you own and answer questions about them. You can ask it to make summaries, charts, or even podcasts from the books.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google's note-taking app and buy digital books, this could be helpful for learning or studying — though it's a new feature you'd have to try to see if it works well for you.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and 100 other companies call for action to defend against rogue AI
stories.simple_summary: Over 100 big tech companies and AI startups signed a statement saying we need to protect against future cyber attacks from AI systems. They also announced a new security solution.
stories.why_it_matters: The security concerns are real, but for most small-business owners, this is early talk — wait to see if this solution actually becomes something practical and affordable you need to use.

stories.title: Jensen Huang says Nvidia achieved AGI, again — not that it matters
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's CEO said his company achieved AGI (which stands for artificial general intelligence — the idea of making an AI as smart as a human at anything). Then he immediately said that goal is pointless and doesn't really mean anything.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly hype and corporate bragging that doesn't mean much — nothing you need to worry about.

stories.title: Google’s AI Mode can now track flight prices, help book hotels, and more
stories.simple_summary: Google's AI Mode (a tool for searching and getting information) can now check flight prices and help you book hotels. It's becoming like having an AI travel agent.
stories.why_it_matters: If you plan trips online, this could save you time — you could ask AI to find and book travel for you instead of doing it yourself.

stories.title: Hugging Face is selling a cute $399 open source duck robot, Microduck
stories.simple_summary: A company called Hugging Face is selling a small robot duck for $399 that you can teach to do tricks by showing it examples.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a novelty toy and hobby item — not something a business owner or older person needs.

stories.title: AI’s memory crunch is coming for Android apps
stories.simple_summary: As AI companies use more computer memory for their data centers, there's a shortage of memory chips. Google is now limiting how much memory Android apps can use so cheaper phones don't run out.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a budget-friendly Android phone, this means apps might run a bit slower or have fewer features to preserve the phone's memory.
